title: Reliable streams and desktop session overview
highlights: Desktop sessions now include a restored Super-key overview with clickable session navigation
The session librarian can now be invoked manually through its slash skill to create safe, versioned Markdown and JSON summaries for the current or a named persisted session
improvements: The desktop overview shortcut works safely across compositors
Session librarian summaries include a handoff brief and relevant files for reuse by the existing handoff workflow
The session librarian uses an independently resolved provider route and enforces hard request, token, cost, and deadline budgets
fixes: Transient stream_read_error failures are now recognized as retryable transport errors
